transcript: Speaker A: Pehli beti hui toh bola ek aur dusri hui toh bola ek aur. 5 saal mein 5 betiyan aur phir woh heart attack se chale gaye. Sasural ne chhoda, mayke ne haath khade kar liye. Mera naam, Zaara hai. Lucknow se, 18 mein shaadi, 23 mein bewah, 5 betiyan. Koi padhai nahi aur English ka E bhi nahi aata tha. Jab bank mein bache paise khatam hone lage toh naukri dhundhne nikli. Call center gayi, Manager ne English mein baat ki. Main chup. Usne kaha, 'we need someone who can speak English.' Wapas aa gayi. Phir betiyon ke school gayi. Form English mein tha. Ek teacher ne ajeeb sa munh banaya. Jab maine kaha ki hindi mein samjha do. Uss din samajh aaya agar main English nahi seekhungi toh meri betiyan bhi peechhe reh jayengi. Ek raat phone par SpeakEasy app ka ad dikha. ₹1 ka trial. Socha ₹1 mein kya jayega? Download kiya. Wahan experts ne Hindi mein samjhakar English bolna sikhaya. Ekdum basic se. Wahi English jo meri zindagi mein chahiye thi. Bank wali, school wali, job wali. Raat ko paanchon betiyon ko sulakar main Vani AI coach se practice karti thi. Ghar mein sannata hota tha aur main phone par apni teacher se kehti hoon 'I am calling about the job opening. My name is Zaara.' AI coach ne 100 baar meri galtiyan sudhaari. Par kabhi mera mazaak nahi udaya. Vo mere sasural ya samaj jaisi nahi thi. Usne kabhi nahi kaha ki tumse nahi hoga. 2 mahine baad main usi call center gayi. Iss baar maine aankhon mein aankhen daalkar bola 'Sir, I have improved my English. I would like another chance.' Manager hairan tha. Mujhe naukri mil gayi. Aaj 3 saal ho gaye. Naukri aur part time kaam milakar main mahine ke 34,000 kamati hoon. English ne mujhe naukri di, naukri ne paisa aur paise ne izzat. Ab jab teacher English mein baat karti hai toh main English mein jawab deti hoon. Meri betiyan mujhe dekhkar muskuraati hain. Mere abbu ab aakar kehte hain ki galti ho gayi. Par ab main kisi ka sahara nahi dhoondhti. Main apni... betiyon ki dhaal khud hoon. SpeakEasy App download karo. Experts ke video dekho. Vani AI coach se practice karo. Roz sirf 15 minute bachchon ko sulaane ke baad agar maa ban gayi ho toh sher ban jao aur sherni ko apni dahaad ke liye English aani chahiye. [When the first daughter was born, they said one more, and when the second was born, they said one more. 5 daughters in 5 years, and then he passed away from a heart attack. My in-laws abandoned me, and my parents' family gave up. My name is Zaara. From Lucknow, married at 18, widowed at 23, with 5 daughters. No education, and I didn't even know the 'E' of English. When the money left in the bank started running out, I went out to look for a job. I went to a call center, the manager spoke in English. I was silent. He said, 'we need someone who can speak English.' I came back. Then I went to my daughters' school. The form was in English. A teacher made a strange face when I asked her to explain in Hindi. That day I realized if I don't learn English, my daughters will also fall behind. One night, I saw an ad for the SpeakEasy app on my phone. A ₹1 trial. I thought, what is there to lose in ₹1? I downloaded it. There, experts taught me to speak English by explaining in Hindi. From the very basics. The exact English I needed in my life. For the bank, for school, for jobs. At night, after putting my five daughters to sleep, I used to practice with the Vani AI coach. There would be silence in the house, and I would say to my teacher on the phone, 'I am calling about the job opening. My name is Zaara.' The AI coach corrected my mistakes 100 times but never made fun of me. It wasn't like my in-laws or society. It never said you can't do it. Two months later, I went to the same call center. This time, looking straight into his eyes, I said, 'Sir, I have improved my English. I would like another chance.' The manager was surprised. I got the job. Today, it has been 3 years. Combining my job and part-time work, I earn 34,000 a month. English gave me a job, the job gave me money, and money gave me respect. Now when the teacher speaks in English, I reply in English. My daughters smile looking at me. My father now comes and says it was a mistake. But now I don't look for anyone's support. I am the shield for my daughters myself. Download the SpeakEasy App. Watch experts' videos. Practice with the Vani AI coach. Just 15 minutes daily after putting the kids to sleep. If you have become a mother, become a lioness, and a lioness needs English for her roar.] Speaker B: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
